mn57:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā koliyesu viharati haliddavasanaṃ nāma koliyānaṃ nigamo.
mn57:2.1: atha kho puṇṇo ca koliyaputto govattiko acelo ca seniyo kukkuravattiko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā puṇṇo koliyaputto govattiko bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. acelo pana seniyo kukkuravattiko bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā kukkurova palikuṇṭhitvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn57:2.2: ekamanataṃ nisinno kho puṇṇo koliyaputto govattiko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn57:2.3: ayaṃ bhante acelo seniyo kukkuravattiko dukkarakārako chamāyaṃ nikkhittaṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjati
mn57:2.4: tassa taṃ kukkuravattaṃ dīgharattaṃ samattaṃ samādinnaṃ
mn57:2.6: alaṃ puṇṇa tiṭṭhatetaṃ mā maṃ etaṃ pucchīti.
mn57:2.7: dutiyampikho puṇṇo koliyaputto govattiko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca ayaṃ bhante acelo seniyo kukkuravattiko dukkarakārako chamāyaṃ nikkhittaṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjati tassa taṃ kukkuravattaṃ dīgharattaṃ samattaṃ samādinnaṃ tassa kā gati ko abhisamparāyoti. alaṃ puṇṇa tiṭṭhatetaṃ mā maṃ etaṃ pucchīti.
mn57:2.8: tatiyampi kho puṇṇo koliyaputto govattiko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn57:2.9: ayaṃ bhante acelo seniyo kukkuravattiko dukkarakārako chamāyaṃ nikkhittaṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjati
mn57:2.10: tassa taṃ kukkuravattaṃ dīgharattaṃ samattaṃ samādinnaṃ
mn57:2.12: addhā kho te ahaṃ puṇṇa na labhāmi
mn57:2.13: alaṃ puṇṇa tiṭṭhatetaṃ mā maṃ etaṃ pucchīti
mn57:3.1: idha puṇṇa ekacco kukkuravattaṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ kukkurasīlaṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ kukkuracittaṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ kukkurākappaṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ
mn57:3.2: so kukkuravattaṃ bhāvetvā paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ kukkurasīlaṃ bhāvetvā paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ kukkuracittaṃ bhāvetvā paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ kukkurākappaṃ bhāvetvā paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā kukkurānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati
mn57:3.3: sace kho panassa evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti imināhaṃ sīlena vā vattena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vāti sāssa hoti micchādiṭṭhi
mn57:3.4: micchādiṭṭhissa kho ahaṃ puṇṇa dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā
mn57:3.5: iti kho puṇṇa sampajjamānaṃ kukkuravattaṃ kukkurānaṃ sahabyataṃ upaneti vipajjamānaṃ nirayanti.
mn57:4.1: evaṃ vutte acelo seniyo kukkuravattiko parodi assūni pavattesi.
mn57:4.2: atha kho bhagavā puṇṇaṃ koliyaputtaṃ govattikaṃ etadavoca
mn57:4.3: etaṃ kho te ahaṃ puṇṇa nālatthaṃ
mn57:4.4: alaṃ puṇṇa tiṭṭhatetaṃ mā maṃ etaṃ pucchīti.
mn57:4.5: nāhaṃ bhante etaṃ rodāmi yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evamāha
mn57:4.6: apica me idaṃ bhante kukkuravattaṃ dīgharattaṃ samattaṃ samādinnaṃ
mn57:4.8: tassa taṃ govattaṃ dīgharattaṃ samattaṃ samādinnaṃ
mn57:4.10: alaṃ seniya tiṭṭhatetaṃ mā maṃ etaṃ pucchīti.
mn57:4.12: tatiyampi kho acelo seniyo kukkuravattiko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn57:4.14: tassa taṃ govattaṃ dīgharattaṃ samattaṃ samādinnaṃ
mn57:4.16: addhā kho te ahaṃ seniya na labhāmi
mn57:4.17: alaṃ seniya tiṭṭhatetaṃ mā maṃ etaṃ pucchīti

mn57:5.2: so govattaṃ bhāvetvā paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ gosīlaṃ bhāvetvā paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ gocittaṃ bhāvetvā paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ gavākappaṃ bhāvetvā paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā gunnaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati
mn57:5.3: sace kho panassa evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti imināhaṃ sīlena vā vattena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vāti sāssa hoti micchādiṭṭhi
mn57:5.4: micchādiṭṭhissa kho ahaṃ seniya dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā
mn57:5.5: iti kho seniya sampajjamānaṃ govattaṃ gunnaṃ sahabyataṃ upaneti vipajjamānaṃ nirayanti.
mn57:6.1: evaṃ vutte puṇṇo koliyaputto govattiko parodi assūni pavattesi.
mn57:6.2: atha kho bhagavā acelaṃ seniyaṃ kukkuravattikaṃ etadavoca
mn57:6.3: etaṃ kho te ahaṃ seniya nālatthaṃ
mn57:6.4: alaṃ seniya tiṭṭhatetaṃ mā maṃ etaṃ pucchīti.
mn57:6.5: nāhaṃ bhante etaṃ rodāmi yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evamāha
mn57:6.6: apica me idaṃ bhante govattaṃ dīgharattaṃ samattaṃ samādinnaṃ
mn57:6.8: pahoti bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yathā ahañcevimaṃ govattaṃ pajaheyyaṃ ayañca acelo seniyo kukkuravattiko taṃ kukkuravattaṃ pajaheyyāti.
mn57:6.9: tenahi puṇṇa suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi bhāsissāmīti.
mn57:6.10: evaṃ bhanteti kho puṇṇo koliyaputto govattiko bhagavato paccassosi.
mn57:7.1: cattārīmāni puṇṇa kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditāni
mn57:7.6: atthi puṇṇa kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇha asukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattatīti.
mn57:8.2: idha puṇṇa ekacco sabyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti sabyāpajjhaṃ vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti sabyāpajjhaṃ manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti
mn57:8.3: so sabyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā sabyāpajjhaṃ vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā sabyāpajjhaṃ manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā sabyāpajjhaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati
mn57:8.4: tamenaṃ sabyāpajjhaṃ lokaṃ upapannaṃ samānaṃ sabyāpajjhā phassā phusanti
mn57:8.5: so sabyāpajjhehi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno sabyāpajjhaṃ vedanaṃ vedeti ekantadukkhaṃ seyyathāpi sattā nerayikāti
mn57:8.6: iti kho puṇṇa bhūtā bhūtassa upapatti hoti
mn57:8.10: idaṃ vuccati puṇṇa kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ.
mn57:9.2: idha puṇṇa ekacco abyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti abyāpajjhaṃ vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti abyāpajjhaṃ manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti
mn57:9.3: so abyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā abyāpajjhaṃ vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā abyāpajjhaṃṭa manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā abyāpajjhaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati
mn57:9.4: tamenaṃ abyāpajjhaṃ lokaṃ upapannaṃ samānaṃ abyāpajjhā phassā phusanti
mn57:9.5: so abyāpajjhehi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno abyāpajjhaṃ vedanaṃ vedeti ekantasukhaṃ seyyathāpi devā subhakiṇhā
mn57:9.6: iti kho puṇṇa bhūtā bhūtassa upapatti hoti
mn57:10.1: katamañca puṇṇa kammaṃ kaṇha sukkaṃ kaṇha sukkavipākaṃ
mn57:10.2: idha puṇṇa ekacco sabyāpajjhampi abyāpajjhampi kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti sabyāpajjhampi abyāpajjhampi vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti sabyāpajjhampi abyāpajjhampi manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti
mn57:10.3: so sabyāpajjhampi abyāpajjhampi kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā sabyāpajjhampi abyāpajjhampi vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā sabyāpajjhampi abyāpajjhampi manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā sabyāpajjhampi abyāpajjhampi lokaṃ upapajjati
mn57:10.4: tamenaṃ sabyāpajjhampi abyāpajjhampi lokaṃ upapannaṃ samānaṃ sabyāpajjhāpi abyāpajjhāpi phassā phusanti
mn57:10.5: so sabyāpajjhehipi abyāpajjhehipi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno sabyāpajjhampi abyāpajjhampi vedanaṃ vedeti vokiṇṇaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ seyyathāpi manussā ekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā
mn57:10.6: iti kho puṇṇa bhūtā bhūtassa upapatti hoti
mn57:10.10: idaṃ vuccati puṇṇa kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇha sukkavipākaṃ.
mn57:11.1: katamañca puṇṇa kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇha asukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati
mn57:11.2: tatra puṇṇa yamidaṃ kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ tassa pahānāya yā cetanā yamidaṃ kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ tassa pahānāya yā cetanā yamidaṃ kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ tassa pahānāya yā cetanā
mn57:11.3: idaṃ vuccati puṇṇa kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
mn57:11.4: imāni kho puṇṇa cattāri kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditānīti.
mn57:12.1: evaṃ vutte puṇṇo koliyaputto govattiko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn57:12.3: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti evameva bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito esāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
mn57:12.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgatanti.
mn57:13.3: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti evameva bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito
mn57:13.4: esāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
mn57:13.5: labheyyāhaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
mn57:14.1: yo kho seniya aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati pabbajjaṃ ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ so cattāro māse parivasati catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya
mn57:14.3: sace kho bhante aññatitthiyapubbā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhantā pabbajjaṃ ākaṅkhantā upasampadaṃ cattāro māse parivasanti catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya ahaṃ cattāri vassāni parivasissāmi catunnaṃ vassānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāyāti.
mn57:15.1: alattha kho acelo seniyo kukkuravattiko bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadaṃ.
mn57:15.2: acirūpasampanno kho panāyasmā seniyo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi
mn57:15.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
mn57:15.4: aññataro ca kho panāyasmā seniyo arahataṃ ahosīti.
